Marissa / team — quick security checklist from our side before procurement signs off:

1) SOC2 Type II report (most recent) + security contact for attestation.
2) Data flows: where EDR telemetry is ingested and stored (cloud region; encryption details). We need confirmation that PII is not retained longer than necessary and mechanisms to purge.
3) Agent behavior: CPU/RAM overhead, auto-update cadence, and allowlisting for our infra images.
4) For vulnerability scanner integration: will SentinelWorks push findings to our internal Jira project or provide an API endpoint? We prefer API exports with role-based tokens.
5) Incident response: post-detection playbooks and support SLA for escalations (dedicated TAM optional).

If SentinelWorks can provide the SOC2 PDF and a short technical note covering items 2–4 before the call, that will speed approvals.

— Mina
Mina Haddad
Security & Compliance Lead | Redwood Inference

Hi Marissa / Mina / team — following up with the materials you requested. Attaching our SOC2 Type II (2025), plus a short technical addendum addressing telemetry retention, agent overhead, and export APIs.

Responses inline:
- SOC2 Type II: attached (SOC2_Type2_AAS_2025.pdf). Our security contact is Nina Alvarez (cc’d) for attestation.
- Telemetry: ingested in us-west-2, AES-256 at rest, TLS 1.3 in transit. Default retention 90 days; configurable to 180 days for an add-on. Data purge APIs are available for on-demand deletion.
- Exports: we provide a paginated API + S3 export hooks; we can also push to Jira via connector.
- SLA: 99.9% console uptime; detection pipeline SLA: initial triage within 2 hours for P1s, full analysis within 24 hours. Dedicated TAM available in enterprise bundle.

Updated quote attached (line items broken out). If the November 24th 9:00 PT slot still works, I’ll send the invite.
